submitted_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, identity-preserving character turnaround.
Asset type: ONE ZeroSQL reference sheet, art-src/refs/ratnikov_sheet.png. Requested PNG canvas 2304×1536, landscape 3:2. This is a neutral development reference sheet, not a dramatic in-game portrait.
Input image 1: approved expressive Ratnikov portrait. Use it as the strong FACE IDENTITY, COSTUME, and ROUGH PAINTERLY STYLE reference. Match this original fictional person's distinctive long, narrow angular face, heavy grey brows, tired kind deep-set eyes, long prominent nose, ears, hairline, grey crewcut, short grey stubble, reading glasses and black neck cord. Do NOT copy the tea, hands, steam, pose, dark navy background, or teal/amber split light.

STYLE PRIORITY: retain the approved reference's boldly angular, expressionist oil-paint character art, close to Disco Elysium portrait sensibility without copying any existing game character. Large broken confident brushstrokes and scraped palette-knife marks, broad jagged simplified masses, graphic planar face anatomy, matte paint. Face, hair, stubble and cardigan are painted as coarse color shapes, never photorealistic microdetail or smoothly rendered digital volume. This stronger expressive style instruction overrides any tendency toward photographic realism. The painting must read immediately as stylized angular oil illustration at thumbnail size.

SHEET LAYOUT: exactly three busts side by side, no panel borders. LEFT strictly front view facing camera, CENTER three-quarter view facing toward the right of the canvas, RIGHT strict side-profile facing right. Head and upper chest only. Same head size and proportions, same eye-line height and the same clothing and glasses in all views. Three views of exactly the SAME man, neutral closed-mouth expression. Do not turn this into three similar relatives. Keep the nose bridge and tip, ear shapes, hairline, chin and age anatomically consistent across rotation. Hair is a short grey crew-cut, facial hair is short grey stubble, NOT a beard.
Reading glasses are worn lowered on his nose in all views, attached to a clearly visible thin BLACK cord that hangs naturally around his neck. The loosened dark tie, pale blue-grey shirt, thick grey cardigan and ONE white-capped translucent nitroglycerin tube in his left shirt breast pocket must remain consistent where visible. Profile may naturally obscure the far-side pocket. No hands and no tea are needed in this head-and-upper-chest framing.
BACKGROUND AND LIGHT: neutral flat solid mid-grey #6E7378 behind all three heads; even soft neutral studio illumination. No dramatic color split, no teal rim, no amber edge, no blue-black shadows, no gradient, no vignette. Keep rough brush texture on the figures rather than in the empty grey background.

qa.expression: Neutral closed mouth across all three views; weary but not distressed.
qa.age_facial_hair: Visually late middle age consistent with specified 58. Short grey stubble with visible short individual brush marks, not a full beard. Hair follows the approved reference's short, rough spiky silhouette.
qa.wardrobe: Consistent thick grey cardigan, pale blue-grey collared shirt, loosened dark tie; no visible insignia, epaulettes, badges or medals.
qa.glasses_cord: Reading glasses lowered on nose in all views, with attached black cord around neck; cord is clearly visible.
qa.tube: One translucent tube with white cap in the visible shirt breast pocket in each view. Tube is unlabelled. Profile shows the same pocket on the near side.
qa.style: Large broken/angular oil-paint marks, simplified face planes, scraped brush texture, rough painted cardigan. Clearly illustrative, not photographic or smooth digital rendering.
qa.background_light: Quiet mid-grey field, neutral overall illumination without teal rim or amber dramatic split. Flesh palette remains warm and the grey background has small pixel variations. NOT an exact flat #6E7378.
qa.framing: Head and upper chest. No hands, tea or additional props. Leftmost cardigan edge reaches canvas boundary but head/face is intact.
qa.text: No visible captions, letters, numbers, labels, logo, signature or watermark.
